global_issues.title: July US Payrolls Contract 23k, Rate Cut Odds Surge
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC, NBC News, Yahoo Finance, Fox Business. Payrolls fell 23,000 vs +83,000 expected, with a combined 103,000-job downward revision to May/June. Unemployment rate ticked down to 4.1% but only because labor force participation fell to 61.4% (lowest since Feb 2021) — a weak-labor-market signal, not a strong one. September Fed hike odds fell to ~44% from ~57% pre-report. Note: Aug 12 CPI print is now flagged by economists as the likely deciding factor for the Fed, which the briefing omits.

global_issues.title: Trump Imposes 15% Tariff on Key Semiconductor Material
global_issues.note: Confirmed by Nikkei Asia, Benzinga, Supply Chain Dive, Yahoo Finance. 15% tariff plus minimum import prices on polysilicon, targeting China's >90% share of global polysilicon supply, invoked under Section 232. One material omission: the tariff does not take effect until Dec. 4, 2026 — the briefing implies immediate market impact, which overstates near-term effect on chip input costs.

missing_major_news.impact: OKLO is cited in the briefing's own headline (+14.77%) as a rally leader, driven by its Groves facility reaching first criticality and Q2 earnings, but OKLO does not appear anywhere in the sector/watchlist analysis, so readers get no context for why it's mentioned in the headline.

missing_major_news.impact: Explains MU's DOWNTREND status and price pressure in more depth (Citigroup cut MU price target 18% to $1,150 despite Buy rating) — briefing's sector note mentions MU is weak but doesn't identify the sector-wide selloff catalyst.

market_mood_check.note: Green/94.7 risk-on read matches reality: S&P 500 +0.6%, Nasdaq +1.3%, second straight week of gains, weak jobs data interpreted as reducing near-term Fed hike risk. PLTR +10.32% figure is accurate but mischaracterized elsewhere as a laggard (see stock_errors).

sector_check.note: MU and TSLA correctly placed in laggards/DOWNTREND given real chip-sector selloff and Tesla's bearish technicals (MACD sell signal) despite a daily price gain. However, PLTR's inclusion in 'Laggards ... remain under pressure with weak Stage2 scores' is inconsistent with reality — PLTR is in the middle of its best earnings-driven rally in a year, up ~35% over the past week, and arguably belongs with the leaders/uptrend group, not alongside TSLA/MU/APP/QBTS.

stock_errors.error: Classified as DOWNTREND / laggard 'under pressure' with weak technical scores, but PLTR is actually rallying hard (+10.32% same-day, ~+35% over the prior week) on blowout Q2 earnings (revenue +93% YoY) and raised guidance plus a bullish BofA note. The technical/trend classification contradicts both the price action shown in the same briefing and the underlying fundamental catalyst.

grok_report.summary: Both global macro items (weak July jobs report, 15% polysilicon tariff) are accurately reported, and the overall green/risk-on market mood matches real conditions. The main flaw is a significant stock-classification error: PLTR is grouped with downtrend laggards despite being the standout rally story of the week on strong Q2 earnings, and that earnings catalyst — along with Oklo's earnings/nuclear milestone referenced in the headline — is missing from the narrative entirely.
